pipelines.name: document-agent
pipelines.description: Build a reusable document-generation skill from reference files. Runs kb-builder to extract product knowledge, then document-generator to compile a custom skill, then the generated skill to produce the final document.

pipelines.name: config-generator
pipelines.description: Generate a final configuration file (JSON, XML, YAML etc.) from reference documents. Runs kb-builder to extract knowledge, then config-agent to produce the config.
